name: Olesno County (Poland)
description: A vertical banner of three vertical stripes, blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the county arms of Olesno: a shield with the Silesian eagle and three red roses.
history: Polish county (powiat) and city flags are established by resolution of the council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
